Name: Tiramisu Recipe
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
Tiramisu (CP) adds a cute, vanilla-style tiramisu as a brand-new cooking item for Stardew Valley 1.6.
What’s in the mod
[list]
[*]New food: Tiramisu
[list]
[*]Sell Price: 400g
[*]Edibility: 50
[*]Buff: +1 Luck for 3 minutes
[*]Hand-drawn 16×16 icon in a vanilla-friendly style
[/list][*]Recipe (always unlocked): Coffee ×1, any Milk ×1, any Egg ×1, Sugar ×1
Appears directly in your cooking menu (use a kitchen or a Cookout Kit).[/list]Requirements
[list]
[*]SMAPI (latest)
[*]Content Patcher (latest)
[i]No Json Assets, SpaceCore, or Expanded Preconditions Utility required.[/i][/list]Download & Install
[list=1]
[*]Download the ZIP.

[*]Unzip into your game’s Mods folder so you have [code]Mods/Tiramisu_CP/manifest.json[/code], [code]content.json[/code], and [code]assets/Objects.png[/code].

[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.

[*]Open a kitchen or use a Cookout Kit to see and cook the recipe.

[/list]Compatible with other CP packs; the item uses a unique key and doesn’t replace vanilla items.
Design by Abrah
